answer_1.quote: In VDU, a model is given an image I and user question q, and predicts text answer a.
answer_1.outputs: textual answers (and intermediate rationales) to questions about visual documents

answer_2.quote: InfoVQA and DocVQA use the average normalized Levenshtein similarity (ANLS) score as the evaluation measure. ChartQA uses relaxed accuracy (RA).
